Anya (Design): quick design check — sharing inline threshold editor v2. focus: keyboard flow, suppression preview, and per-channel unmute. Screenshots attached. Mohit (Eng): compact inline is nice, but discoverability worry for channel group drag handle. people might miss grouping. Ben (Eng): uploaded a mockup with a 12px grab handle and hover affordance. will run with NVDA. link: https://redwood.mockups/inline-threshold-v2.png Katie (PM): copy thought: 'quiet window' vs 'silence window' vs 'snooze' — 'snooze' feels like user action, not policy-based suppression. prefs? Anya (Design): lean toward keeping 'quiet window' since it's in other places. add tooltip: "Quiet window — temporarily suppress notifications for this policy" and a small example: "9:00–17:00" Ben (Eng): a11y nit: preview panel currently placed after controls; screen readers hit it last. suggest add aria-live region or move DOM before controls so previews are announced. Mohit (Eng): contrast nit: amber severity badge fails WCAG AA (1.8:1). propose #B35A00 for amber and update tokens. also ensure focus ring visible on compact pill. Anya (Design): keyboard flow: when tabbing into the threshold slider, focus should land on the numeric input and expose up/down arrow adjustments. Enter commits. we should surface 'Esc' to revert. aria-bot: accessibility: recommend adding aria-label to drag handle: "Reorder notification channel" and using role="list"/role="listitem" for grouping. Ben (Eng): sample aria snippet: ```
...
``` Katie (PM): final asks: in suppression preview show 'Muted channels (2/4)' w/ inline unmute buttons, and expose a compact 'preview-only' toggle for low-vision users. also track telemetry: preview_opened, unmute_clicked. Anya (Design): thanks — i'll iterate mockups with these changes. can we get engineering review for tab order and screenreader announce by EOD? :eyes: Mohit (Eng): yep, I'll try to validate with NVDA + VoiceOver today. ping me when new mockups are up. deploy-bot: uploaded mock: https://redwood.mockups/inline-threshold-v2.png (version 3) Katie (PM): great, will check copy and update spec. :thumbsup:
